project.title: IoT Water Quality Monitoring System
project.shortDescription: An ESP32 IoT system monitoring water pH, turbidity, and temperature in real time.
project.description: Designed an IoT-based system to monitor water quality metrics such as pH, turbidity, and temperature in real time. Integrated cloud-based monitoring and alert systems.
features: Real-time sensor reading collection and transmission.
Automatic calibration curves for pH and turbidity sensors.
Push notification triggers on hazardous water levels.
A cloud dashboard displaying historic telemetry lines.
